name: Paradise Bay Park Family Campground
note: Mostly seasonal: the park map marks about 22 of its roughly 100 sites for nightly campers, and the lakeshore rows are seasonal-only; reservations by phone with a one-night deposit. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site paradisebaypark.com (read 2026-10-21): rentals page sells a campsite by the day ($50) or week, one-night deposit, no application/lease/minimum; 107 wooded sites with W/E 30/50A and RV/5th-wheel pull-thrus (operator description via Campendium); legacy park-map page still served (Last-Modified 2025-06) shows circled seasonal-only sites with ~22 unmarked nightly sites (~20%, passes test 4); RV Life 15 reviews incl. Jul 2026 'mainly a seasonal park with a few sites for travelers', $50/night, and a 2023 Tiffin Allegro Bus stay ('a little tight but doable') -> 23 ft fits; Google 4.6/151 -> real transient RV campground; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-21: operator park map (paradisebaypark.com/id2.html, 2017map.jpg) circles every shoreline site (40-50 along the fishing-deck shore, 76-80 on Paradise Bay, 1-5 by the docks) as permanent/seasonal-only; the unmarked nightly sites (2-9, 11, 15-19, 26-31, 65, 70, 86/86A, 97) sit in the interior rows between the office/pool and the bath house. Esri satellite at 42.0998,-79.7288 (130 m half-width, leaf-off, rendered) shows that interior block ~100+ m from Findley Lake behind wooded, trailer-filled lakeshore rows and the beach/dock/boat-rental strip -> no nightly RV pad on or overlooking the water; defaults down to not waterfront.
fees_source: https://www.paradisebaypark.com/rentals.html (current Weebly site, built Aug 2026; read 2026-10-21): 'Campsite: Day: $50, Week: $300' (week = 6 nights), one sleeping unit per site, $25 extra for an added tent; no hookup or date tiers given. Matches RV Life review Jul 2026 'Nightly Rate: $50 USD'.
flags: Nightly share comes from the 2017 park map (circled = seasonal), the only count found; a Jul 2026 RV Life review says 'mainly a seasonal park with a few sites for travelers', and the park is under new management (Jun 2026 review rated it 'Horrible' for dirty bathrooms), so the split may have shifted - a phone call would confirm.
The operator site's 'Active Seasonal Listings' page advertises seasonal campers for sale in place ($30k-$80k); these are RV resales, not homes or lots, so test 5 was judged passed.
Lakefront sites exist but are seasonal-only per the map, so waterfront was set from the nightly sites.
